run%20the%20five-fold%20calculation.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20This%20was%20an%20**experimental%20stress%20test**.%20The%20papers%20used%20different%20plants%2C%20doses%20and%20response%20measures.%20A%20shared%20label%20name%20did%20not%20make%20their%20biological%20questions%20identical.%20The%20original%20human-reviewed%20policies%20were%20kept%20separate%20and%20unchanged.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Precision%20asks%20how%20often%20a%20predicted%20high%20response%20is%20right.%20Recall%20asks%20how%20many%20real%20high%20responses%20we%20find.%20**F1%20balances%20precision%20and%20recall%3B%201%20is%20best.**%20Balanced%20accuracy%20gives%20high%20and%20low%20responses%20equal%20weight.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Morgan%20logistic%20regression%20reached%20F1%20about%20**0.727**%20in%20the%20pooled%20scaffold%20test.%20The%20majority%20baseline%20had%20F1%20about%20**0.719**.%20Balanced%20accuracy%20was%20about%20**0.656**%2C%20which%20adds%20useful%20context%20beyond%20F1.%20The%20promising-looking%20score%20needed%20a%20harder%20test.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20We%20then%20held%20out%20whole%20papers.%20This%20means%20the%20model%20had%20to%20predict%20a%20study%20whose%20compounds%20and%20labels%20were%20not%20in%20its%20training%20papers.%20Performance%20fell.%20This%20is%20an%20important%20finding%3A%20**being%20able%20to%20fit%20a%20model%20is%20not%20the%20same%20as%20showing%20that%20it%20works%20on%20a%20new%20study**.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(balanced_accuracy_score%2C%20current_tables%2C%20f1_score%2C%20mo%2C%20roc_auc_score)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20current_metric_checks%20%3D%20%5B%5D%0A%20%20%20%20for%20_current_report%20in%20current_tables%5B%22new_paper_reports%22%5D%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20_current_predictions%20%3D%20%5Br%20for%20r%20in%20current_tables%5B%22new_paper_predictions%22%5D%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20if%20all(r%5Bk%5D%20%3D%3D%20_current 0and%20out-of-bag%20importance%0A%0A%20%20%20%20A%20random%20forest%20combines%20many%20decision%20trees.%20A%20tree%20repeatedly%20asks%20questions%20such%20as%20%E2%80%9Cis%20fingerprint%20bit%20j%20present%3F%E2%80%9D%20Different%20trees%20see%20bootstrap%20samples%20of%20rows%20and%20random%20subsets%20of%20available%20features%20at%20each%20split.%20Averaging%20reduces%20dependence%20on%20one%20tree.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Our%20matched%20raw-Morgan%20forest%20uses%20**500%20trees**%2C%20%60min_samples_leaf%20%3D%202%60%2C%20balanced%20class%20weights%2C%20default%20square-root%20feature%20sampling%20at%20splits%2C%20and%20a%20fixed%20seed.%20It%20has%20no%20PCA%20or%20standardization.%20The%20scaffold-held-out%20forest%20result%20in%20section%2010%20is%20its%20principal%20matched%20evaluation%20result.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20What%20OOB%20means%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Bootstrap%20samples%20contain%20repeated%20rows.%20Each%20tree%20leaves%20out%20some%20compounds%3B%20those%20are%20**out-of-bag%20for%20that%20tree**.%20For%20a%20compound%2C%20aggregate%20predictions%20only%20from%20trees%20that%20did%20not%20sample%20it.%20In%20a%20large%20ordinary%20bootstrap%2C%20roughly%2036.8%25%20of%20rows%20are%20omitted%20per%20tree%2C%20but%20actual%20vote%20counts%20vary.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20separate%20full-cohort%20forest%20has%20**OOB%20F1%200.9038**%2C%20with%20at%20least%20**84%20OOB%20votes%20per%20compound**.%20This%20is%20a%20different%20evaluation%20scheme%20from%20five-fold%20scaffold%20holdout.%20Related%20scaffolds%20can%20appear%20among%20a%20tree's%20training%20rows%20even%20when%20a%20particular%20row%20is%20OOB.%20Do%20not%20treat%20the%20higher%20OOB%20F1%20as%20an%20improvement%20over%20the%20scaffold-held-out%20F1%20of%200.8687.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Permutation%20importance%0A%0A%20%20%20%20For%20each%20fingerprint%20bit%2C%20shuffle%20its%20values%20**within%20each%20tree's%20OOB%20rows**%2C%20recompute%20aggregate%20OOB%20predictions%2C%20and%20measure%20%60baseline%20F1%20%E2%88%92%20shuffled%20F1%60.%20Repeat%2010%20times%20with%20seeded%20randomness.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20A%20positive%20drop%20suggests%20the%20fitted%20forest%20relies%20on%20that%20bit%20for%20this%20task.%20Zero%20can%20mean%20unused%2C%20redundant%2C%20rare%20or%20uninformative.%20A%20negative%20drop%20can%20occur%20because%20of%20noise%20or%20because%20disruption%20happens%20to%20improve%20this%20finite%20evaluation.%20Correlated%20features%20can%20mask%20each%20other's%20importance.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**This%20addresses%20the%20request%20for%20OOB-based%20variable%20importance%2C%20but%20it%20is%20not%20a%20significance%20test.**%20The%20SD%20across%20repeated%20shuffles%20is%20descriptive%20Monte%20Carlo%20variability.%20There%20is%20no%20formal%20p-value%20or%20proof%20of%20causation.%20A%20hashed%20bit%20is%20not%20uniquely%20a%20molecular%20fragment%20without%20inspecting%20its%20contributing%20environments%20and%20collisions.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo%2C%20oob)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20_oob_top%20%3D%20sorted(oob%2C%20key%3Dlambda%20r%3Afloat(r%5B%22mean_f1_drop%22%5D)%2C%20reverse%3DTrue)%5B%3A15%5D%0A%20%20%20%20mo.ui.table(_oob_top%2C%20selection%3DNone%2C%20label%3D%22Top%2015%20of%202%2C048%20OOB%20bit%20diagnostics%3B%20full%20table%20retained%20on%20disk%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20Held-out%20permutation%20is%20another%20diagnostic%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20formula%20diagnostic%20separately%20shuffles%20a%20feature%20or%20a%20joint%20halogen%20block%20in%20each%20**held-out%20scaffold%20fold**%2C%20while%20keeping%20that%20fold's%20fitted%20model%20fixed.%20Its%20score%20drop%20uses%20**AUROC**%2C%20not%20F1.%20It%20measures%20disruption%20of%20the%20already-fitted%20model%20rather%20than%20performance%20after%20retraining%20without%20the%20variable.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Ablation%20retrains%20a%20changed%20representation%3B%20permutation%20disrupts%20inputs%20to%20an%20existing%20fit.%20Their%20numbers%20are%20not%20interchangeable.%20Separate%20shuffled-label%20controls%20refit%20the%20complete%20pipeline%20after%20permuting%20targets%3A%20they%20ask%20whether%20the%20pipeline%20can%20produce%20impressive%20scores%20without%20the%20original%20label%20relationship.%20Twenty%20controls%20are%20a%20small%20exploratory%20set%2C%20not%20a%20precise%20significance%20analysis.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Other%20completed%20sensitivity%20checks%20included%20three-%2Ften-fold%20scaffold%20settings%20and%20omission%20of%20the%20largest%20scaffold%20group.%20Omitting%20a%20group%20changes%20the%20evaluated%20population%3B%20it%20does%20not%20estimate%20performance%20on%20that%20omitted%20group.%20No%20one%20diagnostic%20removes%20purposive-selection%20bias.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo%2C%20permutations)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20_perm_groups%20%3D%20%7B%7D%0A%20%20%20%20for%20_r%20in%20permutations%3A%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20_perm_groups.setdefault(_r%5B%22feature%22%5D%2C%20%5B%5D).append(float(_r%5B%22auc_drop%22%5D))%0A%20%20%20%20mo.ui.table(sorted(%5B%7B%22feature%2Fblock%22%3Ak%2C%22mean%20held-out%20AUROC%20drop%22%3Around(sum(v)%2Flen(v)%2C5)%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%22fold-repeat%20values%22%3Alen(v)%7D%20for%20k%2Cv%20in%20_perm_groups.items()%5D%2C%0A%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20key%3Dlambda%20r%3Ar%5B%22mean%20held-out%20AUROC%20drop%22%5D%2C%20reverse%3DTrue)%2C%20selection%3DNone)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%2015.%20Toxicity%3A%20why%20finding%20records%20is%20only%20the%20beginning%0A%0A%20%20%20%20An%20evidence-availability%20flag%20means%20a%20source%20has%20relevant%20information%20under%20a%20retrieval%20policy.%20It%20does%20not%20tell%20you%20the%20magnitude%20of%20a%20toxic%20effect.%20Missing%20evidence%20is%20not%20zero%20toxicity.%20Likewise%2C%20stored%20computational%20predictions%20and%20model-derived%20points%20of%20departure%20must%20remain%20distinct%20from%20experimental%20doses.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20first%20comparison%20deliberately%20restricted%20the%20endpoint%20to%20**experimental%20acute%20rat%20oral%20LD50%20in%20mg%2Fkg**%2C%20with%20approved%20EPA%20identity%20mapping%20and%20supported%20extraction%20rules.%20LD50%20is%20the%20dose%20associated%20with%2050%25%20lethality%20under%20that%20experiment.%20**Lower%20LD50%20indicates%20greater%20acute%20lethal%20toxicity**%2C%20not%20greater%20safety.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20From%205%2C814%20cached%20hazard%20rows%20across%2088%20source%20chemicals%2C%20the%20policy%20retained%20**43%20exact%20and%2025%20censored%20observations**.%20Exact%20observations%20yield%20**34%20compound%20medians%3A%2026%20selected%20herbicides%20and%20eight%20unreviewed%20natural-product%20selections**.%20Another%2015%20compounds%20have%20only%20censored%20evidence.%20This%20cache%20is%20conditioned%20on%20the%20earlier%20selection%3B%20it%20is%20not%20an%20unbiased%20EPA-wide%20discovery%20cohort.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Historical%20pooled%20linear%20tertile%20cutoffs%20are%20frozen%20at%20**1%2C080%20and%203%2C400%20mg%2Fkg**.%20%E2%80%9CLow%2Fmedium%2Fhigh%E2%80%9D%20here%20describes%20**LD50%20values**%3B%20low%20LD50%20means%20higher%20acute%20toxicity.%20These%20are%20cohort-dependent%20descriptive%20bins%2C%20not%20regulatory%20hazard%20categories%20or%20risk%20estimates.%20Risk%20also%20depends%20on%20exposure%2C%20among%20other%20factors.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20A%20median%20summarizes%20heterogeneous%20retained%20studies%3B%20it%20is%20not%20the%20single%20true%20LD50%20of%20a%20molecule.%20Inspect%20individual%20results%2C%20ranges%20and%20context.%20New-cohort%20tertiles%20are%20reported%20separat of%202%2C000.%20With%20the%20frozen%20cutoffs%2C%20this%20observation%20is%20compatible%20with%20medium%20and%20high%20LD50%20bins.%20%60LD50%20%3E%2010%2C000%60%20is%20compatible%20only%20with%20the%20high%20LD50%20bin.%20Bounds%20at%20cutoffs%20require%20their%20strict%20or%20inclusive%20inequality%20to%20be%20respected.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20We%20retain%20compatible%20bins%20for%20each%20**observation**.%20We%20do%20not%20replace%20bounds%20by%20points%20or%20transfer%20an%20observation's%20bin%20to%20a%20compound%20median.%20The%20exact-only%20summary%20necessarily%20excludes%20censored-only%20compounds%2C%20which%20can%20bias%20the%20compared%20subset%3B%20retain%20those%20coverage%20counts%20when%20presenting%20the%20medians.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Sensitivity%20scenarios%20include%20the%20historical%20exact-value%20baseline%2C%20reviewed%20duplicate%20decisions%2C%20exclusion%20of%20unresolved%20overlap%20candidates%2C%20and%20a%20strict%20documented-context%20subset.%20In%20the%20frozen%20expansion%2C%20the%20first%20three%20retained%20the%20same%2043%20exact%20values%20%2F%2034%20compound%20medians.%20There%20were%20no%20approved%20duplicate%20collapses.%20This%20does%20not%20prove%20that%20the%20records%20are%20independent.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20strict%20subset%20requiring%20reference%2C%20sex%2C%20strain%20and%20explicit%20elapsed%20duration%20is%20**empty**.%20It%20reports%20insufficient%20documentation%20rather%20than%20a%20more%20precise%20toxicity%20estimate.%20The%20publication%2Fchemical-hint%20review%20queue%20contains%2018%2C992%20**candidate%20pairs**%2C%20not%2018%2C992%20established%20duplicates.%20Matching%20values%20alone%20do%20not%20establish%20duplicate%20observations.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(censors%2C%20missingness%2C%20mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.vstack(%5Bmo.ui.table(censors%2Cselection%3DNone%2Clabel%3D%22All%2025%20censored%20observations%20and%20compatible%20bins%22)%2C%0A%20%2 0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20dictionary%20codes%20matter%3A%20immobilization%20requires%20**ITX%2FIMBL**%3B%20%60IMM%60%20means%20immunological.%20The%20strict%20context%20screens%20found%20**28%20trout%20and%2013%20Daphnia%20slots**%2C%20each%20distinct%20within%20those%20strata.%20Measured%20versus%20unmeasured%20exposure%20concentrations%20remain%20separate%3A%20trout%206%2F22%20and%20Daphnia%201%2F12.%20Different%20concentration%20bases%2Fformulations%20must%20not%20be%20pooled%20casually.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20At%20the%20original%20expansion%20checkpoint%2C%20all%20104%20source%20identities%20were%20candidates.%20Your%20subsequent%20explicit%20identity%20review%20has%20now%20approved%20all%20104%20mappings%20in%20a%20new%20crosswalk%2C%20admitting%2028%20trout%20and%2013%20Daphnia%20core-policy%20observations%20to%20canonical%20exports.%20The%20new%20opening%20section%20explains%20the%20remaining%20exposure-duration%2Fcontrol%20documentation%20gaps.%20A%20DTXSID%20overlap%20alone%20still%20does%20not%20supply%20source-specific%20approval%20for%20future%20mappings.%20Ecological%20LC50%2FEC50%20concentrations%20and%20mammalian%20oral%20LD50%20doses%20are%20not%20one%20toxicity%20scale.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(aquatic%2C%20mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.ui.table(aquatic%2Cselection%3DNone%2Cpagination%3DFalse%2Clabel%3D%22Source-context%20coverage%20versus%20identity-approved%20coverage%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%2017.%20The%20literature%20review%3A%20what%20was%20recovered%20and%20what%20still%20needs%20judgment%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%2015%20named%20leads%20have%20matching%20database%20and%20name-reconstructed%20full%20InChIKeys.%20That%20is%20helpful%20identity%20evidence%2C%20but%20**name%20reconstruction%20is%20not%20independent%20validation%20of%20the%20original%20paper's%20drawing%2C%20spectra%2C%20stereochemistry%20or%20tested%20form**.%20Free%20acid%2C%20ester%2C%20salt%20and%20formulation%20claims%20must%20refer%20to%20the%20actual%20studied%20material.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20expansion%20recovered%20the%20**1998%20full%20methods%2Fresults**.%20Solution%20experiments%20used%20three%20dishes%20with%2020%20seeds%20each%2C%20assessing%20lettuce%20at%20six%20days%20and%20barnyard%20millet%20at%20four%20days.%20Soil%20lettuce%20tests%20used%20four%20cups%20of%20five%20germinating%20seeds%20at%20five%20days.%20Graphical%20responses%20were%20retained%20as%20author%20categories%20unless%20numeric%20data%20were%20actually%20available%3B%20plots%20were%20not%20silently%20converted%20into%20invented%20exact%20values.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20original%20packets%20contained%20**81%20observations%20by%20study%2Ftreatment**%2C%20expanded%20to%20**119%20condition%20records**%20in%20the%20second-pass%20workbook%2C%20rather%20than%20one%20universal%20outcome%20per%20compound.%20Examples%20of%20issues%20to%20explain%3A%0A%0A%20%20%20%20-%20The%202020%20experiment%20has%20control%20mortality%20that%20affects%20interpretation%20of%20treatment%20death%20percentages.%0A%20%20%20%20-%20The%202024%20field%20study%20differs%20by%20site%2C%20dose%2C%20formulation%20and%20weed%20context.%20Low%20response%20at%20UPV%20under%20one%20base%20treatment%20is%20not%20universal%20inactivity%3B%20GUA%20results%20can%20differ.%0A%20%20%20%20-%20Sarmentine's%202015%20methods%20state%20**10%20mg%2FmL**%2C%20while%20table%20headings%20state%20**20%20mg%2FmL**.%20Its%20activity%20proposal%20remains%20unknown%20pending%20resolution.%20A%2091%E2%80%93100%25%20injury%20band%20is%20not%20an%20exact%20response%20of%20100%25.%0A%20%20%20%20-%20Natural-occurrence%20sources%20must%20characterize%20the%20exact%20molecule.%20Evidence%20for%20an%20ester%20does%20not%20automatically%20prove%20occurrence%20of%20the%20free%20acid.%0A%20%20%20%20-%20Li%207b%20%2F%20CHEMBL2253255%20retains%20its%20original%20**N-allyl%20ver even-column%20label%20interface%20remains%20unchanged.%20It%20requires%20references%20for%20known%20origin%20and%20references%2Fcontext%2Fa%20shared%20policy%20for%20known%20activity.%20Companion%20tables%20hold%20the%20detailed%20study%20evidence%20and%20approval%20history.%20A%20parser%20accepting%20a%20row%20proves%20schema%20consistency%2C%20not%20scientific%20correctness.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20An%20origin%20approval%20does%20not%20require%20approving%20activity.%20A%20documented%20dietary%20use%20does%20not%20establish%20plant%20inactivity.%20Missing%20activity%20evidence%20does%20not%20establish%20inactivity.%20A%20low-response%20label%20is%20meaningful%20only%20under%20its%20explicit%20policy.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20explicit%20decisions%20have%20been%20transferred%20to%20new%20versioned%20label%20sets%2C%20with%20identity%20holds%2C%20same-structure%20checks%20and%20independent%20class%2Fscaffold%20support%20checks.%20Before%20future%20biological%20model%20fitting%2C%20expand%20the%20independent%20support%20**under%20each%20policy**.%20Do%20not%20pool%20incompatible%20policies%20just%20to%20make%20the%20sample%20size%20large%20enough.%20This%20notebook%20does%20not%20read%20or%20overwrite%20your%20working%20approvals.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%2019.%20Reproducibility%3A%20what%20%E2%80%9Cverified%E2%80%9D%20means%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20saved%20bundles%20record%20exact%20input%2C%20code%2C%20dependency-lock%20and%20output%20hashes%2C%20plus%20settings%2C%20seeds%20and%20versions.%20A%20SHA-256%20match%20detects%20byte%20changes.%20It%20does%20not%20validate%20scientific%20interpretation%2C%20guarantee%20an%20external%20service%20was%20correct%2C%20or%20reproduce%20missing%20manual%20curation%20from%20a%20fresh%20clone.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20This%20notebook%20checks%20the%20recorded%20hash%20of%20**each%20CSV%20it%20loads**%2C%20rejects%20altered evidence-processing%20and%20structural-modeling%20workflows.%20The%20current%20models%20distinguish%20the%20selected%20compound%20groups%2C%20and%20adopted%20the%20supported%20human-reviewed%20labels.%20Activity%20modeling%20still%20requires%20broader%20independent%20scaffold%20support%20under%20each%20assay%20policy.%E2%80%9D%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20A%20possible%20model%20explanation%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%E2%80%9CEach%20molecule%20becomes%20a%20vector%20of%20formula%2C%20descriptor%20or%20fingerprint%20features.%20We%20keep%20molecules%20with%20the%20same%20core%20scaffold%20together%20during%20five-fold%20evaluation.%20All%20learned%20preprocessing%20is%20fitted%20only%20on%20training%20rows.%20The%20held-out%20predictions%20show%20that%20simple%20composition%20is%20strongly%20discriminative%20for%20this%20selection%3B%20coefficients%20and%20feature-removal%20controls%20help%20explain%20that%20result.%E2%80%9D%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%23%20A%20possible%20closing%0A%0A%20%20%20%20%E2%80%9CThe%20next%20useful%20step%20is%20to%20complete%20source-specific%20identity%20and%20activity-policy%20review%20and%20obtain%20more%20independently%20supported%20low-response%20chemistry.%20We%20should%20preserve%20assay%20context%20and%20scaffold%20diversity%20before%20fitting%20a%20biological%20activity%20model.%E2%80%9D%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%2021.%20Questions%20your%20professor%20may%20ask%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**1.%20Are%20you%20predicting%20herbicidal%20activity%3F**%0A%20%20%20%20Selection%20models%20predict%20selection%20membership.%20We%20also%20tried%20a%20separate%20pooled%20activity%20experiment%2C%20but%20its%20targets%20came%20from%20incompatible%20assays%20and%20transfer%20to%20new%20papers%20was%20poor.%20Human-adopted%20individual%20policies%20still%20lack%20adequate%20class%2Fscaffold%20support.%20There%20is%20no%20accepted%20general%20activity%20predictor.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**2.%20Why%20did%20you%20choose%20logistic%20regression%3F**%0A%20%20%20%20It%20is%20a%20regularized%2C%20interpretable%20baseline%20suitable%20for%20asking%20whether%20chemistry%20separates%20these%20groups.%20A%20forest%20adds%20a%20nonlinear%20comparison%20on%20the%20same%20raw%20fingerprints.%20No%20model%20family%20is%20presumed%20biologically%20correct.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**3.%20How%20did%20you%20select%20variables%3F**%0A%20%20%20%20We%20predeclared%20chemistry%20representations%2C%20removed%20training%20constants%20in%20the%20PCA%20pipeline%2C%20used%20fold-local%20PCA%20and%20L2%20shrinkage%2C%20and%20ran%20block%20ablations%2Fimportance%20diagnostics.%20We%20did%20not%20discover%20a%20final%20causal%20subset%20or%20perform%20univariate%20p-value%20filtering.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**4.%20Why%2095%25%20PCA%20variance%3F**%0A%20%20%20%20It%20is%20the%20fixed%20dimensionality-reduction%20setting%20used%20in%20the%20baseline%2C%20balancing%20compression%20and%20retention%20of%20training%20feature%20variation.%20It%20is%20not%2095%25%20predictive%20information%20and%20was%20not%20selected%20using%20outer%20test%20outcomes.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**5.%20Why%20not%20always%20use%20fingerprints%3F**%0A%20%20%20%20They%20encode%20more%20connectivity%2C%20but%20more%20dimensions%20do%20not%20guarantee%20better%20performance%2C%20especially%20with%20171%20compounds%20and%20selection-related%20composition%20differences.%20The%20matched%20results%20are%20empirical%20comparisons%20for%20this%20task.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**6.%20What%20does%20a%20positive%20nitrogen%20coefficient%20mean%3F**%0A%20%20%20%20Higher%20standardized%20nitrogen%20count%20is%20associated%20with%20the%20selected%20herbicide%20class%20conditional%20on%20the%20other%20formula%20features%20in%20these%20fitted%20models.%20It%20does%20not%20establish%20that%20adding%20nitrogen%20causes%20herbicidal%20activity.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**7.%20Did%20the%20forest%20give%20significant%20variables%3F**%0A%20%20%20%20It%20gave%20OOB%20permutation%20importance%3A%20the%20F1%20change%20when%20a%20bit%20is%20disrupted.%20Repeat%20SD%20is%20not%20a%20p-value%2C%20and%20hashed%20bits%20require%20mapping%20before%20chemical%20interpretation.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**8.%20Why%20is%20OOB%20better%20than%20nothing%20but%20insufficient%20here%3F**%0A%20%20%20%20It%20avoids%20predicting%20each%20compound%20with%20trees%20that%20sampled%20that%20compound.%20It%20does%20not%20hold%20related%20scaffolds%20out%2C%20so%20it%20addresses%20a%20weaker%20separation%20than%20scaffold%20validation.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**9.%20Does%20an%20apparent%20natural-product%20false%20positive%20identify%20a%20candidate%20herbicide%3F**%0A%20%20%20%20It%20is%20a%20selection-model%20disagreement%2C%20not%20validated%20activity%20evidence.%20It%20may%20motivate%20investigation%20but%20does%20not%20establish%20efficacy.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**10.%20Are%20natural%20products%20safer%3F**%0A%20%20%20%20Natural%20occurrence%20does%20not%20establish%20safety.%20Our%20bounded%20rat%20oral%20comparison%20and%20ecological%20context%20screens%20describe%20retained%20evidence%3B%20they%20do%20not%20support%20a%20universal%20safety%20claim.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**11.%20Why%20not%20pool%20all%20toxicity%20values%3F**%0A%20%20%20%20Different%20species%2C%20routes%2C%20effects%2C%20durations%2C%20units%20and%20concentration%20bases%20measure%20different%20things.%20Matching%20an%20endpoint%20abbreviation%20alone%20is%20insufficient.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**12.%20What%20is%20the%20strongest%20current%20limitation%3F**%0A%20%20%20%20The%20purposive%20cohorts%20and%20insufficient%20scaffold%20diversity%20within%20accepted%20activity%20policies%20limit%20biological%20interpretation.%20Several%20source%20identities%2C%20treatment%20contexts%20and%20duplicate%20candidates%20still%20need%20adjudication.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**13.%20What%20did%20the%20expansion%20achieve%3F**%0A%20%20%20%20The%20earlier%20source%20expansion%20recovered%20methods%2Fresults%20and%20made%20decisions%20reviewable.%20Later%20work%20added%20experimental%20activity%20fits%2C%20failed-transfer%20tests%2C%20source-linked%20toxicity%20reviews%20and%20two%20protein%20complexes.%20The%20new%20external-estimate%20analysis%20is%20planned%2C%20not%20completed.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20**14.%20What%20would%20count%20as%20stronger%20next%20evidence%3F**%0A%20%20%20%20Primary%20source%20identity%20confirmation%2C%20accepted%20policies%20and%20decisions%2C%20negative-bearing%20scaffold%20diversity%2C%20independent%20validation%20data%2C%20and%20genuinely%20comparable%20toxicity%20context.%20These%20strengthen%20the%20target%20and%20evaluation%20rather%20than%20merely%20adding%20another%20classifier.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%2022.%20Practice%3A%20explain%20it%20without%20looking%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Try%20answering%20these%20first.%20Then%20open%20the%20answer%20key%20below.%0A%0A%20%20%20%201.%20What%20are%20X%20and%20y%20in%20the%20completed%20structural%20comparison%3F%0A%20%20%20%202.%20Which%20steps%20must%20be%20fitted%20separately%20inside%20a%20training%20fold%2C%20and%20why%3F%0A%20%20%20%203.%20Does%20PCA%20select%20the%20original%20variables%20most%20associated%20with%20activity%3F%0A%20%20%20%204.%20What%20do%20smaller%20C%2C%20a%20positive%20coefficient%2C%20and%20balanced%20class%20weights%20each%20mean%3F%0A%20%20%20%205.%20Why%20can%20raw%20formula%20and%20PCA%20formula%20have%20different%20interpretations%3F%0A%20%20%20%206.%20Why%20is%2067.8%25%20ordinary%20accuracy%20a%20weak%20baseline%20here%3F%0A%20%20%20%207.%20Why%20is%20the%20forest%20OOB%20F1%20not%20directly%20comparable%20with%20scaffold-held-out%20F1%3F%0A%20%20%20%208.%20What%20is%20the%20difference%20between%20retraining%20an%20ablation%20and%20permuting%20a%20fitted%20model's%20feature%3F%0A%20%20%20%209.%20How%20should%20%60LD50%20%3E%202%2C000 es%20a%20separate%20full-cohort%20fit%20and%20a%20different%20validation%20scheme.%0A%20%20%20%208.%20Ablation%20lets%20the%20model%20relearn%20without%20a%20block.%20Permutation%20disrupts%20a%20feature%20while%20keeping%20the%20fitted%20model%20fixed.%0A%20%20%20%209.%20Retain%20it%20as%20a%20lower%20bound%20with%20compatible%20medium%2Fhigh%20observation%20bins%3B%20do%20not%20invent%20a%20point%20value%20or%20a%20compound%20median.%0A%20%20%20%2010.%20One%20native%20result%20can%20contain%20multiple%20slots%2C%20and%20studies%20can%20contribute%20multiple%20results.%20Preserve%20all%20levels%20and%20count%20each%20explicitly.%0A%20%20%20%2011.%20Review%20identities%20and%20policies%2C%20approve%20evidence-backed%20decisions%2C%20version%20labels%2C%20retain%20holds%2Fconflicts%2C%20and%20check%20both-class%20scaffold%20support%20under%20each%20policy.%0A%20%20%20%2012.%20The%20target%20is%20selection%20membership%20in%20a%20purposive%20cohort%2C%20not%20verified%20herbicidal%20activity.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22%20if%20show_answers.value%20else%20%22*Answer%20the%20questions%20aloud%2C%20then%20reveal%20the%20key.*%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20%23%23%2023.%20Current%20priorities%20after%20the%20presentation%0A%0A%20%20%20%201.%20Follow%20the%20new%20%5Bmodeled-evidence%20handoff%5D(..%2Fhandoffs%2Fmodeled-evidence-2026-11-12%2FREADME.md)%3A%20broad%20acquisition%20is%20the%20first%20priority.%0A%20%20%20%202.%20Grow%20experimental%20and%20external-model%20datasets%20separately%2C%20with%20exact%20identities%2C%20versions%2C%20units%2C%20study%20context%2C%20applicability%20domain%20and%20clear%20unknowns.%0A%20%20%20%203.%20Model%20each%20evidence%20pathway%20separately%20after%20freezing%20a%20collection%20release.%20Report%20baselines%2C%20held-out%20results%20and%20unsupported%20cases.%0A%20%20%20%204.%20Compare%20matched%20measurements%20and%20estimates.%20Check%20w
